answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake bond before it can transact, slashed on proven fraud. A lone actor spinning up a thousand sock-puppet agents must fund a thousand bonds, so attack cost scales linearly while honest newcomers pay only once. Like a bridge toll on a narrow ridge road, the fee is trivial for one genuine traveller but ruinous for a convoy of fakes; a public beacon ledger listing bonded identities lets peers verify stake before trusting a new counterparty.
